critical_code_review_comments: FreeTrialCTA input has both HTML5 `type="email" required` AND a JS regex check. HTML5 validation may pre-empt the sonner toast for wholly-invalid strings like 'notanemail' (browser native tooltip shows first). Verified sonner toast still fires for edge cases HTML5 accepts but the JS regex rejects (e.g. 'a@b'). Consider removing HTML5 `required`/using `type=text` if consistent sonner UX is desired.

Backend free_trial_start dedups on (email, ip_hash, fingerprint_hash) IN ORDER. When multiple visitors share an egress IP (e.g. corporate NAT, or curl+browser from the same test host), any new email from that IP is silently pushed to the waitlist with device_blocked=true. This is the intended one-per-device rule but is worth confirming with product for shared-network cases.
